Add {{tl|deletion}} or {{tl|del}} to the top of a page to mark it for deletion. The template will display a warning and add the page to [[:Category:Deletion]] for an admin to review.

Adding a pipe (<code>|</code>) after either command will change the default text to appear instead 
as the editor's "reasoning" for the deletion.<br>
There is no need to type a period at the end of the reasoning, as a period is already provided in the template.

For example, <code><nowiki>{{del|This is a sample deletion request}}</nowiki></code> will appear as...
{{del|This is a sample deletion request|cat=nocat}}

== Alternatives ==
{{tl|Wrong namespace}}, for use on a page in an incorrect namespace
